answer: Require every new identity to lock a refundable bond in a pearl vault and pass a 30-day island trial of attested work before it can earn echo reputation. Only accounts with verified history may vouch for newcomers, and a voucher loses its own bond if the newcomer is later proven fake. A sybil attacker must therefore fund a separate bond and a month of genuine work for each fake identity, so forging a thousand identities costs a thousand bonds plus a thousand months of labor, while an honest user pays a single bond that is refunded in full.
